title: Integral scalar localization preserves the specified exchange arrow
statement: For the canonical bounded constructible comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-comparisons] and a commutative square of separated finite-type k-schemes with characteristic different from ℓ, the source comparison followed by the specified continuous E exchange at scalar extension of K equals scalar extension of the specified integral exchange at K followed by the target comparison. No exchange or push comparison is inverted; properness and Cartesianity are not required.

theorem integralConstructible_exchange_equality
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) :
    integralConstructibleSourceHom ℓ E k f g K ≫
        (boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app
          ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E X).obj K) =
      (integralScalarConstructible ℓ E Y').map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app K) ≫
        integralConstructibleTargetHom ℓ E k f' g' K
